name: renyiDivergence_two_nonneg
doc:
**`α = 2` 的 Rényi 散度非负**（Cauchy–Schwarz）：
`p ≥ 0`、`q > 0`、`Σ p = Σ q = 1` ⟹ `0 ≤ D_2(p‖q)`。
证明：`(Σ p_i)² = (Σ (p_i/√q_i)·√q_i)² ≤ (Σ p_i²/q_i)·(Σ q_i) = Σ p_i²/q_i`，
故 `Σ p_i²/q_i ≥ 1`，取 `log` 得非负。
stmt:
theorem renyiDivergence_two_nonneg {n : ℕ} (p q : Fin n → ℝ) (_hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hpsum : ∑ i, p i = 1) (hqsum : ∑ i, q i = 1) :
    0 ≤ renyiDivergence 2 p q
proof:
by
  rw [renyiDivergence_two_eq p q hq]
  have hsq : ∀ i : Fin n, Real.sqrt (q i) ≠ 0 := fun i => ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hq i))
  have hcs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))
    (fun i => p i / Real.sqrt (q i)) (fun i => Real.sqrt (q i))
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.sum_attach, true_implies] at hcs
  have hleft : (∑ i : Fin n, p i / Real.sqrt (q i) * Real.sqrt (q i)) = ∑ i, p i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ (p i) (hsq i)
  have hright1 : (∑ i : Fin n, (p i / Real.sqrt (q i)) ^ 2) = ∑ i, p i ^ 2 / q i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hq i))]
  have hright2 : (∑ i : Fin n, (Real.sqrt (q i)) ^ 2) = ∑ i, q i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hq i))]
  rw [hleft, hpsum, hright1, hright2, hqsum, mul_one, one_pow] at hcs
  exact Real.log_nonneg hcs

name: renyiDivergence_prodPmf_additive
doc:
**Rényi 散度的乘积可加性**（**组合定理的核心**）：
`D_α(p₁⊗p₂ ‖ q₁⊗q₂) = D_α(p₁‖q₁) + D_α(p₂‖q₂)`。
证明：`Real.mul_rpow` 拆幂 + 双重和分解为乘积（`Fintype.sum_prod_type`、
`Finset.sum_mul_sum`）+ `Real.log_mul`。
stmt:
theorem renyiDivergence_prodPmf_additive {m n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin m)] [Nonempty (Fin n)]
    (α : ℝ) (p₁ : Fin m → ℝ) (p₂ : Fin n → ℝ) (q₁ : Fin m → ℝ) (q₂ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hp₁ : ∀ i, 0 < p₁ i) (hp₂ : ∀ j, 0 < p₂ j) (hq₁ : ∀ i, 0 < q₁ i)
    (hq₂ : ∀ j, 0 < q₂ j) :
    renyiDivergence α (prodPmf p₁ p₂) (prodPmf q₁ q₂)
      = renyiDivergence α p₁ q₁ + renyiDivergence α p₂ q₂
proof:
by
  have hterm : (∑ x : Fin m × Fin n,
        prodPmf p₁ p₂ x ^ α * prodPmf q₁ q₂ x ^ (1 - α))
      = (∑ i : Fin m, p₁ i ^ α * q₁ i ^ (1 - α))
        * (∑ j : Fin n, p₂ j ^ α * q₂ j ^ (1 - α)) := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp only [prodPmf]
    rw [Real.mul_rpow (le_of_lt (hp₁ i)) (le_of_lt (hp₂ j)),
      Real.mul_rpow (le_of_lt (hq₁ i)) (le_of_lt (hq₂ j))]
    ring
  have hApos : 0 < ∑ i : Fin m, p₁ i ^ α * q₁ i ^ (1 - α) :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hp₁ i) α)
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hq₁ i) (1 - α))) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hBpos : 0 < ∑ j : Fin n, p₂ j ^ α * q₂ j ^ (1 - α) :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hp₂ j) α)
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hq₂ j) (1 - α))) Finset.univ_nonempty
  unfold renyiDivergence
  rw [hterm, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hApos) (ne_of_gt hBpos)]
  ring

name: rdpDelta_add_eq_mul
doc: **δ 关于复合可乘**：`δ(α, ε₁+ε₂) = δ(α,ε₁)·δ(α,ε₂)`。
stmt:
theorem rdpDelta_add_eq_mul (α ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ) :
    rdpDelta α (ε₁ + ε₂) = rdpDelta α ε₁ * rdpDelta α ε₂
proof:
by
  unfold rdpDelta
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  ring_nf

name: renyiDP_compose
doc:
**Rényi DP 组合定理**：若两个机制分别满足 `D_α ≤ ε₁`、`D_α ≤ ε₂`，
则其乘积（独立复合）机制满足 `D_α ≤ ε₁ + ε₂`。
stmt:
theorem renyiDP_compose {m n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin m)] [Nonempty (Fin n)]
    {α ε₁ ε₂ : ℝ} (p₁ : Fin m → ℝ) (p₂ : Fin n → ℝ) (q₁ : Fin m → ℝ) (q₂ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hp₁ : ∀ i, 0 < p₁ i) (hp₂ : ∀ j, 0 < p₂ j) (hq₁ : ∀ i, 0 < q₁ i)
    (hq₂ : ∀ j, 0 < q₂ j)
    (h₁ : renyiDivergence α p₁ q₁ ≤ ε₁) (h₂ : renyiDivergence α p₂ q₂ ≤ ε₂) :
    renyiDivergence α (prodPmf p₁ p₂) (prodPmf q₁ q₂) ≤ ε₁ + ε₂
proof:
by
  rw [renyiDivergence_prodPmf_additive α p₁ p₂ q₁ q₂ hp₁ hp₂ hq₁ hq₂]
  exact add_le_add h₁ h₂

name: rpow_sum_le_of_renyiDivergence_le
doc:
**RDP 参数 ⟹ 幂和界**：由 `D_α` 的定义与 `(α−1) > 0` 直接得到
`Σ p^α q^{1−α} ≤ exp((α−1)ε')`（`Real.log_le_iff_le_exp`）。
stmt:
theorem rpow_sum_le_of_renyiDivergence_le {n : ℕ} (p q : Fin n → ℝ) {α ε' : ℝ}
    (hα : 1 < α) (hpos : 0 < ∑ i, p i ^ α * q i ^ (1 - α))
    (h : renyiDivergence α p q ≤ ε') :
    (∑ i, p i ^ α * q i ^ (1 - α)) ≤ Real.exp ((α - 1) * ε')
proof:
by
  have hα1 : 0 < α - 1 := by linarith
  have hlog : Real.log (∑ i, p i ^ α * q i ^ (1 - α)) ≤ (α - 1) * ε' := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (le_of_lt hα1)
    have hinv : (α - 1) * ((α - 1)⁻¹ * Real.log (∑ i, p i ^ α * q i ^ (1 - α)))
        = Real.log (∑ i, p i ^ α * q i ^ (1 - α)) := by
      field_simp
    unfold renyiDivergence at this
    linarith [this, hinv]
  exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hpos).mp hlog

doc:
**RDP 事件界（诚实降级：Hölder 步骤为显式假设）**：
若 `Σ p^α q^{1−α} ≤ exp((α−1)ε')` 且（Hölder 假设）对任意事件 `E`

name: rdp_event_bound_of_delta
doc:
**RDP → `(ε,δ)` 的事件界**：在 `rdp_event_bound` 的假设下，
若事件满足 `Σ_{i∈E} q_i ≤ δ`，则 `Σ_{i∈E} p_i ≤ exp(ε')·δ^{1−1/α}`。
stmt:
theorem rdp_event_bound_of_delta {n : ℕ} (p q : Fin n → ℝ) {α ε' δ : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α)
    (hε' : 0 ≤ ε') (_hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i)
    (hrdp : (∑ i, p i ^ α * q i ^ (1 - α)) ≤ Real.exp ((α - 1) * ε'))
    (hholder : ∀ E : Finset (Fin n),
      (∑ i in E, p i)
        ≤ (∑ i in E, p i ^ α * q i ^ (1 - α)) ^ (1 / α)
          * (∑ i in E, q i) ^ (1 - 1 / α)) :
    ∀ E : Finset (Fin n), (∑ i in E, q i) ≤ δ →
      (∑ i in E, p i) ≤ Real.exp ε' * δ ^ (1 - 1 / α)
proof:
by
  intro E hE
  have hα0 : 0 < α := by linarith
  have hexp : 0 < 1 - 1 / α := by
    rw [sub_pos, div_lt_one hα0]
    linarith
  calc (∑ i in E, p i)
      ≤ Real.exp ε' * (∑ i in E, q i) ^ (1 - 1 / α) :=
        rdp_event_bound p q hα hε' hp hq hrdp hholder E
    _ ≤ Real.exp ε' * δ ^ (1 - 1 / α) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => le_of_lt (hq i))) hE hexp.le)
          (Real.exp_pos ε').le

name: dpsgd_noise_scale_of_rdp
doc:
**噪声尺度 ⟹ RDP 参数**（显式换算）：若 `σ² ≥ αΔ²/(2ε')`，则
`gaussianRDPEpsilon α Δ σ ≤ ε'`。
stmt:
theorem dpsgd_noise_scale_of_rdp {α Δ σ ε' : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hε' : 0 < ε')
    (h : α * Δ ^ 2 / (2 * ε') ≤ σ ^ 2) :
    gaussianRDPEpsilon α Δ σ ≤ ε'
proof:
by
  unfold gaussianRDPEpsilon
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * σ ^ 2)]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ε')] at h
  nlinarith [h, sq_nonneg σ, sq_nonneg Δ, hε', hσ]

name: rdp_delta_of_log_bound
doc:
**RDP 参数 ⟹ δ 的显式换算**：`(α−1)·ε' ≤ log(1/δ)` ⟹
`δ ≤ rdpDelta α ε' = exp(−(α−1)ε')`。
stmt:
theorem rdp_delta_of_log_bound {α ε' δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (h : (α - 1) * ε' ≤ Real.log (1 / δ)) :
    δ ≤ rdpDelta α ε'
proof:
by
  have hlog : Real.log δ = -Real.log (1 / δ) := by
    rw [Real.log_div one_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hδ), Real.log_one]
    ring
  have hle : Real.log δ ≤ -(α - 1) * ε' := by
    rw [hlog]; linarith
  calc δ = Real.exp (Real.log δ) := (Real.exp_log hδ).symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(α - 1) * ε') := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hle
    _ = rdpDelta α ε' := rfl

name: dpsgd_gaussian_delta
doc:
**高斯机制 + 噪声尺度的 `(ε,δ)` 显式换算（条件定理）**：
给定（显式假设，诚实降级）高斯机制的 RDP 界 `ε'(α) ≤ ε'_0`，以及
`(α−1)ε'_0 ≤ log(1/δ)`，则 `δ ≤ exp(−(α−1)ε'_0)`。
这里 `ε'(α) = αΔ²/(2σ²)` 是 `RealDPSGD` 中噪声方差 `σ²C²` 的 RDP 对应参数。
stmt:
theorem dpsgd_gaussian_delta {α Δ σ δ ε'₀ : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α) (hδ : 0 < δ) (_hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hrdp : gaussianRDPEpsilon α Δ σ ≤ ε'₀)
    (h : (α - 1) * ε'₀ ≤ Real.log (1 / δ)) :
    δ ≤ rdpDelta α (gaussianRDPEpsilon α Δ σ)
proof:
by
  have hα1 : 0 < α - 1 := by linarith
  have hmono : (α - 1) * gaussianRDPEpsilon α Δ σ ≤ (α - 1) * ε'₀ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrdp (le_of_lt hα1)
  exact le_trans (rdp_delta_of_log_bound hδ (le_trans hmono h))
    (le_of_eq (by rfl))

name: gaussianRDPEpsilon_antitone
doc:
**与 `RealDPSGD` 噪声结构的对接**：`RealDPSGD.privacyProxy σ = 1/σ` 单调，
且其噪声方差 `RealDPSGD.noiseVariance σ C = σ²C²` 与 `gaussianRDPEpsilon` 的分母一致：
`gaussianRDPEpsilon α Δ σ = αΔ²/(2σ²)` 关于 `σ` 严格递减（`σ > 0`）。
stmt:
theorem gaussianRDPEpsilon_antitone {α Δ : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hΔ : Δ ≠ 0)
    {σ₁ σ₂ : ℝ} (h₁ : 0 < σ₁) (hle : σ₁ ≤ σ₂) :
    gaussianRDPEpsilon α Δ σ₂ ≤ gaussianRDPEpsilon α Δ σ₁
proof:
by
  unfold gaussianRDPEpsilon
  have h₂ : 0 < σ₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le h₁ hle
  have hsq : σ₁ ^ 2 ≤ σ₂ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hnum : 0 < α * Δ ^ 2 := mul_pos hα (pow_pos (abs_pos.mpr hΔ) 2 |>.trans_eq (by rw [sq_abs]))
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * σ₂ ^ 2) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * σ₁ ^ 2)]
  nlinarith [hsq, hnum, sq_nonneg σ₁, sq_nonneg σ₂]

end Lattice

name: transpose_isPlan
doc: 转置：`p → q` 的传输计划转置后是 `q → p` 的传输计划。
stmt:
theorem transpose_isPlan {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    {p : α → ℝ} {q : β → ℝ} {π : α → β → ℝ} (hπ : IsTransportPlan p q π) :
    IsTransportPlan q p (fun b a => π a b)
proof: ⟨fun b a => hπ.1 a b, fun b => hπ.2.2 b, fun a => hπ.2.1 a⟩

name: transportCost_transpose
doc: 一维代价下，传输代价在转置下不变（`∑∑` 交换 + `|a - b| = |b - a|`）。
stmt:
theorem transportCost_transpose (π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) :
    transportCost (absCost n) (fun b a => π a b) = transportCost (absCost n) π
proof:
by
  simp only [transportCost, absCost]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  rw [abs_sub_comm]

name: transportCost_absCost_nonneg
doc: 非负代价下传输代价非负。
stmt:
theorem transportCost_absCost_nonneg {p q : Fin n → ℝ} {π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ}
    (hπ : IsTransportPlan p q π) : 0 ≤ transportCost (absCost n) π
proof:
by
  simp only [transportCost, absCost]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => mul_nonneg (hπ.1 a b) (abs_nonneg _)

name: W1_bddBelow
doc: 可行计划集（的代价像）有下界（下界取 `0`）。
stmt:
theorem W1_bddBelow (p q : Fin n → ℝ) :
    BddBelow (transportCost (absCost n) '' {π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π})
proof:
⟨0, fun y hy => by
    rcases hy with ⟨π, hπ, rfl⟩
    exact transportCost_absCost_nonneg hπ⟩

name: W1_image_nonempty
doc: 可行计划集非空 ⟹ 其代价像非空。
stmt:
theorem W1_image_nonempty {p q : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b) (hq1 : ∑ b, q b = 1) :
    (transportCost (absCost n) '' {π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π}).Nonempty
proof: ⟨_, fun a b => p a * q b, productPlan_isPlan p q hp0 hp1 hq0 hq1, rfl⟩

name: W1_image_comm
doc: 可行计划集的像关于 `p, q` 交换不变（转置是双射）。
stmt:
theorem W1_image_comm (p q : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (transportCost (absCost n) '' {π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π}) =
      (transportCost (absCost n) '' {σ : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan q p σ})
proof:
by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨π, hπ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fun b a => π a b, transpose_isPlan hπ, transportCost_transpose π⟩
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fun a b => σ b a, transpose_isPlan hσ, transportCost_transpose σ⟩

name: diagonalPlan_isPlan
doc: 对角计划是传输计划（要求 `p` 非负）。
stmt:
theorem diagonalPlan_isPlan {p : Fin n → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) :
    IsTransportPlan p p (diagonalPlan p)
proof:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b
    change 0 ≤ (if a = b then p a else 0)
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · rw [if_pos hab, hab]
      exact hp0 b
    · rw [if_neg hab]
  · intro a
    change (∑ x : Fin n, (if a = x then p a else 0)) = p a
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ a (fun _ => p a)]
    simp
  · intro b
    change (∑ x : Fin n, (if x = b then p x else 0)) = p b
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ b p]
    simp

name: diagonalPlan_cost
doc: 对角计划的传输代价为 `0`（因为只有 `a = b` 的项，而 `|a - a| = 0`）。
stmt:
theorem diagonalPlan_cost (p : Fin n → ℝ) :
    transportCost (absCost n) (diagonalPlan p) = 0
proof:
by
  simp only [transportCost, diagonalPlan, absCost]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · simp [hab]
  · simp [hab]

name: W1_nonneg
doc: **非负性**：概率向量下 `0 ≤ W1 p q`（可行集非空 + 每个可行代价非负）。
stmt:
theorem W1_nonneg {p q : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b) (hq1 : ∑ b, q b = 1) :
    0 ≤ W1 p q
proof:
by
  rw [W1]
  refine le_csInf (W1_image_nonempty hp0 hp1 hq0 hq1) ?_
  rintro y ⟨π, hπ, rfl⟩
  exact transportCost_absCost_nonneg hπ

name: W1_self
doc: **同一性**：`W1 p p = 0`（对角计划给出 `W1 p p ≤ 0`，非负性给出反向）。
stmt:
theorem W1_self {p : Fin n → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1) :
    W1 p p = 0
proof:
by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (W1_nonneg hp0 hp1 hp0 hp1)
  have hmem : transportCost (absCost n) (diagonalPlan p) ∈
      transportCost (absCost n) '' {π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p p π} :=
    ⟨diagonalPlan p, diagonalPlan_isPlan hp0, rfl⟩
  rw [W1]
  calc sInf (transportCost (absCost n) '' {π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p p π})
      ≤ transportCost (absCost n) (diagonalPlan p) := csInf_le (W1_bddBelow p p) hmem
    _ = 0 := diagonalPlan_cost p

name: W1_comm
doc: **对称性**：`W1 p q = W1 q p`（代价像在转置下相等 ⟹ 下确界相等）。
stmt: theorem W1_comm (p q : Fin n → ℝ) : W1 p q = W1 q p
proof:
by
  unfold W1
  rw [W1_image_comm]

name: W1_triangle_aux
doc:
**gluing 的代价界**（三角不等式的核心）：给定可行计划
`π₁ : p → q`、`π₂ : q → r`，粘合计划
`γ a c = ∑ b, π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b` 是 `p → r` 的可行计划，且
`W1 p r ≤ transportCost c γ ≤ transportCost c π₁ + transportCost c π₂`。
要求 `∀ b, 0 < q b`（见文件头 docstring 的降级说明）。
stmt:
theorem W1_triangle_aux {p q r : Fin n → ℝ} {π₁ π₂ : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ}
    (hπ₁ : IsTransportPlan p q π₁) (hπ₂ : IsTransportPlan q r π₂)
    (hqpos : ∀ b, 0 < q b) :
    W1 p r ≤ transportCost (absCost n) π₁ + transportCost (absCost n) π₂
proof:
by
  have hqne : ∀ b, q b ≠ 0 := fun b => ne_of_gt (hqpos b)
                             
  have hγ1 : ∀ a c, 0 ≤ ∑ b, π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b := by
    intro a c
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ =>
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hπ₁.1 a b) (hπ₂.1 b c)) (le_of_lt (hqpos b))
  have hγ2 : ∀ a, ∑ c, ∑ b, π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b = p a := by
    intro a
    have hb : ∀ b, (∑ c, π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b) = π₁ a b := by
      intro b
      have h1 : (∑ c, π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b)
          = π₁ a b * ((∑ c, π₂ b c) / q b) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div, Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => by ring
      rw [h1, hπ₂.2.1 b, div_self (hqne b), mul_one]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => hb b]
    exact hπ₁.2.1 a
  have hγ3 : ∀ c, ∑ a, ∑ b, π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b = r c := by
    intro c
    have hb : ∀ b, (∑ a, π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b) = π₂ b c := by
      intro b
      have h1 : (∑ a, π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b)
          = (∑ a, π₁ a b) * (π₂ b c / q b) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by ring
      rw [h1, hπ₁.2.2 b, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (hqne b)]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => hb b]
    exact hπ₂.2.2 c
  have hγ : IsTransportPlan p r (fun a c => ∑ b, π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b) := ⟨hγ1, hγ2, hγ3⟩
                 
  have hA : transportCost (absCost n) (fun a c => ∑ b, π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b)
      = ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, (π₁ a b * π₂ b c / q b) * |(a : ℝ) - (c : ℝ)| := by

name: W1_triangle
doc:
**三角不等式**：`W1 p r ≤ W1 p q + W1 q r`。

由 `W1_triangle_aux` 对 `π₁`、`π₂` 分别取下确界得到：
`W1 p r - W1 q r ≤ W1 p q`，即结论。

**降级（标注）**：附加假设 `hqpos : ∀ b, 0 < q b`（中间分布处处正）；
无条件下标版本（`q b = 0` 的分支）**未做**，见文件头 docstring。
stmt:
theorem W1_triangle {p q r : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b) (hq1 : ∑ b, q b = 1)
    (hr0 : ∀ c, 0 ≤ r c) (hr1 : ∑ c, r c = 1)
    (hqpos : ∀ b, 0 < q b) :
    W1 p r ≤ W1 p q + W1 q r
proof:
by
  have hne1 := W1_image_nonempty hp0 hp1 hq0 hq1
  have hne2 := W1_image_nonempty hq0 hq1 hr0 hr1
  have step : W1 p r - W1 q r
      ≤ sInf (transportCost (absCost n) '' {π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π}) := by
    refine le_csInf hne1 ?_
    rintro y ⟨π₁, hπ₁, rfl⟩
    have h2 : W1 p r - transportCost (absCost n) π₁
        ≤ sInf (transportCost (absCost n) '' {σ : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan q r σ}) := by
      refine le_csInf hne2 ?_
      rintro z ⟨π₂, hπ₂, rfl⟩
      have := W1_triangle_aux hπ₁ hπ₂ hqpos
      linarith
    linarith [show W1 q r
        = sInf (transportCost (absCost n) '' {σ : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan q r σ})
        from rfl]
  linarith [show W1 p q
      = sInf (transportCost (absCost n) '' {π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π})
      from rfl]

name: kp_lipschitz_bound_swap
doc: 1-Lipschitz 势的反向差分界：`f b - f a ≤ |a - b|`。
stmt:
theorem kp_lipschitz_bound_swap {f : Fin n → ℝ} (hf : IsOneLipschitz f) (a b : Fin n) :
    f b - f a ≤ |(a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)|
proof:
by
  have h : -(f a - f b) ≤ |f a - f b| := neg_le_abs _
  linarith [hf a b]

name: isOneLipschitz_neg
doc: 1-Lipschitz 在取负下封闭。
stmt:
theorem isOneLipschitz_neg {f : Fin n → ℝ} (hf : IsOneLipschitz f) :
    IsOneLipschitz (fun a => -f a)
proof:
by
  intro a b
  have h : -f a - -f b = -(f a - f b) := by ring
  rw [h, abs_neg]
  exact hf a b

name: isOneLipschitz_add_const
doc: 1-Lipschitz 在加常数下封闭。
stmt:
theorem isOneLipschitz_add_const {f : Fin n → ℝ} (hf : IsOneLipschitz f) (k : ℝ) :
    IsOneLipschitz (fun a => f a + k)
proof:
by
  intro a b
  have h : (f a + k) - (f b + k) = f a - f b := by ring
  rw [h]
  exact hf a b

name: kr_upper
doc:
**Kantorovich–Rubinstein（上界方向，即 `sup ≤ W1`）**：
对 1-Lipschitz 的 `f : Fin n → ℝ`，`∑ a, f a * (p a - q a) ≤ W1 p q`。

证明：取 `g b = -f b`，由 1-Lipschitz 有 `f a + g b = f a - f b ≤ |a - b|`，
用 OT 文件的 `dual_weak` 得对每个可行计划 `π` 的界，再对可行集取 `le_csInf`。

**未做（标注）**：反方向 `W1 p q ≤ sup_f ∑ a, f a * (p a - q a)`
（需构造最优 Kantorovich 势）本文件**未做**。
stmt:
theorem kr_upper {p q : Fin n → ℝ} {f : Fin n → ℝ} (hf : IsOneLipschitz f)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b) (hq1 : ∑ b, q b = 1) :
    ∑ a, f a * (p a - q a) ≤ W1 p q
proof:
by
  rw [W1]
  refine le_csInf (W1_image_nonempty hp0 hp1 hq0 hq1) ?_
  rintro y ⟨π, hπ, rfl⟩
  have hsplit : ∑ a, f a * (p a - q a) = (∑ a, f a * p a) - (∑ a, f a * q a) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by ring
  have hneg : ∑ a, (-f a) * q a = -(∑ a, f a * q a) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by ring
  have hdw : (∑ a, f a * p a) + (∑ a, (-f a) * q a)
      ≤ transportCost (absCost n) π :=
    dual_weak p q (absCost n) π f (fun a => -f a) hπ
      (fun a b => le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hf a b))
  calc ∑ a, f a * (p a - q a)
      = (∑ a, f a * p a) - (∑ a, f a * q a) := hsplit
    _ = (∑ a, f a * p a) + (∑ a, (-f a) * q a) := by rw [hneg]; ring
    _ ≤ transportCost (absCost n) π := hdw

name: W1_le_product_cost
doc:
**乘积计划上界**：`W1 p q ≤ ∑ a ∑ b, p a * q b * |a - b|`
（乘积计划可行，故其代价不小于下确界）。
stmt:
theorem W1_le_product_cost {p q : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b) (hq1 : ∑ b, q b = 1) :
    W1 p q ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, p a * q b * |(a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)|
proof:
by
  have hmem : transportCost (absCost n) (fun a b => p a * q b) ∈
      transportCost (absCost n) '' {π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π} :=
    ⟨fun a b => p a * q b, productPlan_isPlan p q hp0 hp1 hq0 hq1, rfl⟩
  have hcost : transportCost (absCost n) (fun a b => p a * q b)
      = ∑ a, ∑ b, p a * q b * |(a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)| := by
    simp only [transportCost, absCost]
  rw [W1]
  calc sInf (transportCost (absCost n) '' {π : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ | IsTransportPlan p q π})
      ≤ transportCost (absCost n) (fun a b => p a * q b) := csInf_le (W1_bddBelow p q) hmem
    _ = ∑ a, ∑ b, p a * q b * |(a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)| := hcost

end Lattice.Lib.InfoTheory.RealWasserstein

name: regret_eq_sum_pull_gaps
doc:
**悔的分解恒等式**：若 `N : Fin K → ℕ` 记录了每个臂被拉的次数
（`∑ i, N i = T`），且 `pulls : Fin T → Fin K` 是实际拉臂序列，
则「逐时刻间隙之和」`∑ t, (μ* − μ (pulls t))` 等于 `regret` 定义中的
`∑ i, Δ i * N i`——**前提是** `N` 与 `pulls` 一致（后者恰是前者的计数）。
stmt:
theorem regret_eq_sum_pull_gaps {g : Fin K → ℝ} {N : Fin K → ℕ} {T : ℕ}
    (pulls : Fin T → Fin K)
    (hcount : ∀ i : Fin K, (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin T => pulls t = i)).card = N i) :
    (∑ t : Fin T, g (pulls t)) = regret g N
proof:
by
  classical
                                                                            
  have hfiber : ∀ i : Fin K,
      (∑ t in Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin T => pulls t = i), g (pulls t))
        = (N i : ℝ) * g i := by
    intro i
                                                       
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t ht => by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).2])]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, hcount i, nsmul_eq_mul]
                                                                 
                                         
                                                        
                                                                
                                                             
  have hpart := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin T))) (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)))
    (g := pulls) (f := fun t => g (pulls t)) (fun t _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
                                                                                           
  rw [← hpart]
  unfold regret
                                                                                   
                                                       
                                                                   
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [hfiber i, mul_comm]

name: ucb_index_excludes_suboptimal
proof:
by

name: ucb_not_argmax_suboptimal
doc:
定理 2 的**严格分离推论**：在同样的置信事件与间隙条件下，
UCB 指数对次优臂严格小于对最优臂——特别地，`i` 不可能是指数**最大**的臂
（除非同时 `star` 也达到最大值，而严格不等式排除了这一点）。

name: not_pulled_under_good_event
stmt:
theorem not_pulled_under_good_event {muHat : Fin K → ℝ} {c : Fin K → ℝ}
    {mu : Fin K → ℝ} {i star : Fin K} {T : ℕ}
    (pulledAt : Fin T → Fin K → Prop)
    (halg : ∀ t : Fin T, pulledAt t i → ∀ j : Fin K, ucbIndex muHat c j ≤ ucbIndex muHat c i)
    (hi : |muHat i - mu i| ≤ c i) (hstar : |muHat star - mu star| ≤ c star)
    (hgap : 2 * c i + 2 * c star < mu star - mu i) :
    ∀ t : Fin T, ¬ pulledAt t i
proof:
by
  intro t ht
  exact absurd (halg t ht) (ucb_not_argmax_suboptimal hi hstar hgap)

name: pull_count_zero_under_good_event
doc: 由定理 3：好事件下臂 `i` 的拉次数为 0。
stmt:
theorem pull_count_zero_under_good_event {muHat : Fin K → ℝ} {c : Fin K → ℝ}
    {mu : Fin K → ℝ} {i star : Fin K} {T : ℕ}
    (pulls : Fin T → Fin K)
    (halg : ∀ t : Fin T, pulls t = i → ∀ j : Fin K, ucbIndex muHat c j ≤ ucbIndex muHat c i)
    (hi : |muHat i - mu i| ≤ c i) (hstar : |muHat star - mu star| ≤ c star)
    (hgap : 2 * c i + 2 * c star < mu star - mu i) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin T => pulls t = i)).card = 0
proof:
by
  apply Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
  rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  intro t ht
  exact not_pulled_under_good_event (fun t j => pulls t = j) halg hi hstar hgap t
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).2

name: ucb_confidence_radius
stmt:
theorem ucb_confidence_radius {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {X : α → ℝ} (μ : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α) (hmean : uniformExpectation X = μ)
    (hb : ∀ x : α, |X x| ≤ 1) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → α =>
        c ≤ |(∑ i : Fin n, X (w i)) / n - μ|)) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 / 8)
proof: hoeffding_two_sided μ n hn hN hmean hb hc

name: good_event_prob
stmt:
theorem good_event_prob {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (X : Fin K → α → ℝ) (μ : Fin K → ℝ) (n : ℕ) {c : ℝ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α)
    (hmean : ∀ i : Fin K, uniformExpectation (X i) = μ i)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin K, ∀ x : α, |X i x| ≤ 1) (hc : 0 < c) :
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → α =>
        ∃ i : Fin K, c ≤ |(∑ t : Fin n, X i (w t)) / n - μ i|))
      ≤ ∑ _i : Fin K, 2 * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 / 8)
proof:
by
  classical
                                  
  let bad : Fin K → Finset (Fin n → α) := fun i =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun w => c ≤ |(∑ t : Fin n, X i (w t)) / n - μ i|)
  have hunion : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → α =>
      ∃ i : Fin K, c ≤ |(∑ t : Fin n, X i (w t)) / n - μ i|))
      = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).biUnion bad := by
    ext w
                                                           
                                                            
                                                                  
                                                          
                                                             
                                                       
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_biUnion, bad]
  rw [hunion]
  calc
    uniformProb ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)).biUnion bad)
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin K, uniformProb (bad i) :=
          union_prob_le_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin K)) bad
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin K, 2 * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 / 8) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          exact ucb_confidence_radius (μ i) n hn hN (hmean i) (hb i) hc

name: good_event_prob_two
doc:
联合界的两臂特例（显式展开，便于引用）：`K = 2` 时坏事件概率
≤ `2 · 2 e^{−n c²/8}`。
stmt:
theorem good_event_prob_two {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (X : Fin 2 → α → ℝ) (μ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (n : ℕ) {c : ℝ}
    (hn : 0 < n) (hN : 0 < Fintype.card α)
    (hmean : ∀ i : Fin 2, uniformExpectation (X i) = μ i)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ x : α, |X i x| ≤ 1) (hc : 0 < c) :
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → α =>
        ∃ i : Fin 2, c ≤ |(∑ t : Fin n, X i (w t)) / n - μ i|))
      ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 / 8)
proof:
by
  have h := good_event_prob X μ n hn hN hmean hb hc
  calc
    uniformProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin n → α =>
        ∃ i : Fin 2, c ≤ |(∑ t : Fin n, X i (w t)) / n - μ i|))
        ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 2, 2 * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 / 8) := h
    _ = 4 * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * c ^ 2 / 8) := by
                                                                  
                                                     
                                                            
                                                               
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          ring

（因 `Real.log 1 = 0`），故任何「确定性 ≤」形式的界都无法容纳

**算式的存在形式**：文献界在 `T = 1` 时为 `0`，而「拉一次」对应 `1 > 0`。
**仍是算术陈述**，不含算法语义（见本节的诚实标注）。

    ∃ (bound : ℝ) (pulls : ℕ), bound = 8 * Real.log 1 / (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧ pulls = 1 ∧ bound < (pulls : ℝ)

by

  simp

name: expected_regret_decomposition
proof:
by

  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hgood i)

name: regret_le_total_pulls
doc:
定理 7 的**最坏情形推论**：若所有臂的拉次数被 `T` 控制且间隙 ≤ 1，
则悔 ≤ `T`（平凡但正确的界，用于说明「无概率输入时的确定性退化」）。
stmt:
theorem regret_le_total_pulls {g : Fin K → ℝ} {N : Fin K → ℕ} {T : ℕ}
    (hgap : ∀ i : Fin K, g i ≤ 1)
    (hN : ∑ i : Fin K, N i ≤ T) :
    regret g N ≤ T
proof:
by
  unfold regret
  calc
    ∑ i : Fin K, g i * (N i : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i : Fin K, 1 * (N i : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgap i) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    _ = ∑ i : Fin K, (N i : ℝ) := by simp
    _ = ((∑ i : Fin K, N i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; rfl
    _ ≤ T := by exact_mod_cast hN

end Lattice

name: marginalLikelihood_pos
doc: **正先验 + 正似然 ⟹ 边缘似然为正**。
stmt:
lemma marginalLikelihood_pos {prior lik : Fin n → ℝ} [Nonempty (Fin n)]
    (hp : ∀ θ, 0 < prior θ) (hl : ∀ θ, 0 < lik θ) : 0 < marginalLikelihood prior lik
proof:
by
  unfold marginalLikelihood
  obtain ⟨θ₀⟩ := ‹Nonempty (Fin n)›
  refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => le_of_lt (mul_pos (hp i) (hl i))) ?_
  exact ⟨θ₀, Finset.mem_univ θ₀, mul_pos (hp θ₀) (hl θ₀)⟩

name: bayesUpdate_normalized
doc: **Bayes 更新归一化**：`∑ θ, bayesUpdate prior lik θ = 1`（`Z ≠ 0` 时）。

by

  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self hZ

name: bayesUpdate_prob
doc: **后验是概率向量**：正先验 + 正似然 ⟹ `bayesUpdate prior lik` 满足 `ProbVec`。
stmt:
theorem bayesUpdate_prob {prior lik : Fin n → ℝ} [Nonempty (Fin n)]
    (hp : ∀ θ, 0 < prior θ) (hl : ∀ θ, 0 < lik θ) : ProbVec (bayesUpdate prior lik)
proof:
by
  have hZpos := marginalLikelihood_pos hp hl
  refine ⟨fun θ => ?_, bayesUpdate_normalized (ne_of_gt hZpos)⟩
  unfold bayesUpdate
  exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hp θ)) (le_of_lt (hl θ))) (le_of_lt hZpos)

name: bayesUpdate_proportional
doc: Bayes 更新的本质：`post θ ∝ prior θ · lik θ`（成比例）。

name: squaredRisk_eq_variance_add
doc:
**恒等式**：平方风险 = 后验方差 + (θ̂ − 后验均值)²。
这是「最小化平方风险 = 取后验均值」的全部代数内容。

证明：记 `μ := posteriorMean post`。展开
`(θ̂ − θ)² = ((θ̂ − μ) + (μ − θ))² = (θ̂ − μ)² + 2(θ̂ − μ)(μ − θ) + (μ − θ)²`，
对 `post` 加权求和。交叉项 `2(θ̂ − μ) · ∑ θ, post θ · (μ − θ)` 因
`∑ post θ · μ = μ · 1 = μ` 与 `∑ post θ · θ = μ` 而为 0。
stmt:
lemma squaredRisk_eq_variance_add (post : Fin n → ℝ) (hpost : ∑ θ, post θ = 1)
    (θhat : ℝ) :
    squaredRisk post θhat
      = (∑ θ, post θ * ((θ : ℝ) - posteriorMean post) ^ 2)
        + (θhat - posteriorMean post) ^ 2
proof:
by
  set μ : ℝ := posteriorMean post with hμ
  have hμdef : μ = ∑ η, post η * (η : ℝ) := rfl
                                     
  have hcross : ∑ θ, post θ * (μ - (θ : ℝ)) = 0 := by
    have ha : ∑ θ, post θ * μ = μ := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hpost, one_mul]
    have hb : ∑ θ, post θ * (θ : ℝ) = μ := by rw [hμdef]
    calc ∑ θ, post θ * (μ - (θ : ℝ))
        = ∑ θ, (post θ * μ - post θ * (θ : ℝ)) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun θ _ => by ring
      _ = ∑ θ, post θ * μ - ∑ θ, post θ * (θ : ℝ) := Finset.sum_sub_distrib
      _ = μ - μ := by rw [ha, hb]
      _ = 0 := sub_self μ
         
  have hpt : ∀ θ : Fin n,
      post θ * (θhat - (θ : ℝ)) ^ 2
        = post θ * (θhat - μ) ^ 2 + 2 * (θhat - μ) * (post θ * (μ - (θ : ℝ)))
          + post θ * ((θ : ℝ) - μ) ^ 2 := by
    intro θ
    ring
  unfold squaredRisk
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun θ _ => hpt θ]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have h1 : ∑ θ : Fin n, post θ * (θhat - μ) ^ 2 = (θhat - μ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hpost, one_mul]
  have h2 : ∑ θ : Fin n, 2 * (θhat - μ) * (post θ * (μ - (θ : ℝ)))
      = 2 * (θhat - μ) * ∑ θ, post θ * (μ - (θ : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [h1, h2, hcross, mul_zero, add_zero, hμdef]
  ring

name: posterior_mean_minimizes_squared_risk
doc:
**后验均值最小化平方风险**：对任意估计 `θ̂`，
    `squaredRisk post (posteriorMean post) ≤ squaredRisk post θ̂`。

证明：由恒等式 `R(θ̂) = Var + (θ̂ − θ̄)²`，取 `θ̂ = θ̄` 时第二项为 0，
而第一项（后验方差）非负且与 `θ̂` 无关。
proof:
by
  have h1 := squaredRisk_eq_variance_add post hpost.2 (posteriorMean post)
  have h2 := squaredRisk_eq_variance_add post hpost.2 θhat
  have hvar : 0 ≤ ∑ θ, post θ * ((θ : ℝ) - posteriorMean post) ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun θ _ => mul_nonneg (hpost.1 θ) (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [h1, h2]
  nlinarith [hvar, sq_nonneg (θhat - posteriorMean post)]

    sq_pos_of_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)

name: median_minimizes_abs_risk_left_support
doc:
**中位数最小化绝对误差风险（支撑在左侧 + 右移的充分条件）**：
若后验支撑含于 `(-∞, x]`（即所有参数 `θ ≤ x`），则
`absRisk post x ≤ absRisk post y` 对任意 `y ≥ x` 成立。

证明：对每个 `θ ≤ x ≤ y`，
`|x − θ| = x − θ ≤ y − θ = |y − θ|`。
逐点比较后加权求和即得。

**诚实降级**：一般情形（支撑跨越 `x` 两侧，或 `y < x`）的完整结论
——「中位数 `x` 使 `absRisk post x ≤ absRisk post y`（`y ≥ x`）」
需要按 `{θ ≤ x}`、`{x ≤ θ ≤ y}`、`{y ≤ θ}` 划分后比较两侧质量的大小，
本文件**未做**该一般证明；此处给出的是「支撑在左侧」这一
**充分条件**下的可证版本。
stmt:
theorem median_minimizes_abs_risk_left_support {post : Fin n → ℝ} (hpost : ProbVec post)
    {x : ℝ} (hsupp : ∀ θ : Fin n, (θ : ℝ) ≤ x) {y : ℝ} (hy : x ≤ y) :
    absRisk post x ≤ absRisk post y
proof:
by
  unfold absRisk
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun θ _ => ?_
  have hpn := hpost.1 θ
  have hθx : (θ : ℝ) ≤ x := hsupp θ
  have hx : |x - (θ : ℝ)| = x - θ := abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hy' : |y - (θ : ℝ)| = y - θ := abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)
  rw [hx, hy']
  nlinarith [hpn, hy]

doc: **逐点精确值（左段）**：若 `t ≤ x ≤ y`，则 `|y − t| − |x − t| = y − x`。
stmt:
theorem abs_diff_eq_of_le_left {x y t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    |y - t| - |x - t| = y - x
proof:
by
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ y - t),
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ x - t)]
  ring

name: abs_diff_ge_neg
doc:
**逐点下界（反向三角不等式）**：对任意 `x, y, t`，
`|y − t| − |x − t| ≥ −|y − x|`。
stmt: theorem abs_diff_ge_neg {x y t : ℝ} : |y - t| - |x - t| ≥ -|y - x|
proof:
by
  have h : |x - t| ≤ |x - y| + |y - t| := by
    have := abs_sub_le_iff.mp (le_refl |x - t|)
    calc |x - t| = |(x - y) + (y - t)| := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ |x - y| + |y - t| := abs_add_le _ _
  rw [abs_sub_comm x y] at h
  linarith

name: bayesRisk_le_worstCase
doc:
**Bayes 风险 ≤ 最坏情形风险**：对任何决策规则 `δ` 与上界 `M`，
若 `∀ θ, R(θ, δ) ≤ M` 且 `prior` 是概率向量，则 `bayesRisk prior L δ ≤ M`。

证明：`∑ θ, prior θ · R(θ, δ) ≤ ∑ θ, prior θ · M = M · ∑ θ, prior θ = M`。
stmt:
theorem bayesRisk_le_worstCase {prior : Fin n → ℝ} (hp : ProbVec prior)
    {L : Loss n m} {δ : DecisionRule m} {M : ℝ} (hM : worstCaseRisk L δ M) :
    bayesRisk prior L δ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold bayesRisk
  have hstep : ∑ θ, prior θ * risk L θ δ ≤ ∑ θ, prior θ * M :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun θ _ =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM θ) (hp.1 θ)
  have hconst : ∑ θ : Fin n, prior θ * M = M := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hp.2, one_mul]
  linarith [hstep, hconst.symm.le, hconst.le]

name: bayesRisk_le_minimaxRisk
doc:
**Bayes 风险 ≤ minimax 风险**（下界形式）：若 `M` 是 minimax 风险的下界
（每个规则都有某参数使其风险 ≥ M），且 `prior` 是概率向量，
则对任意规则 `δ` 有 `M ≤ sup` 意义下的界——特别地，
`bayesRisk prior L δ ≤ ` 该规则的最坏情形风险。

这里给出可直接使用的推论形式：`minimax` 下界 `M` 不大于任何规则的 Bayes 风险
之上的最坏情形风险。
stmt:
theorem bayesRisk_le_minimaxRisk {prior : Fin n → ℝ} (_hp : ProbVec prior)
    {L : Loss n m} {δ : DecisionRule m} {M : ℝ} (hM : MinimaxLowerBound L M) :
    ∃ θ : Fin n, M ≤ risk L θ δ
proof: hM δ

name: bayesRisk_le_minimax_upper
doc:
**Bayes 风险不超过任何给出 minimax 上界的量**：
若 `M` 同时是「每个 θ 的风险上界」（对某 δ），则 `bayesRisk ≤ M`。
这是 `bayesRisk_le_worstCase` 的直接重述，单独列出以便引用。
stmt:
theorem bayesRisk_le_minimax_upper {prior : Fin n → ℝ} (hp : ProbVec prior)
    {L : Loss n m} {δ : DecisionRule m} {M : ℝ} (hM : worstCaseRisk L δ M) :
    bayesRisk prior L δ ≤ M
proof: bayesRisk_le_worstCase hp hM

name: unique_bayes_admissible
doc:
**唯一 Bayes 规则 ⟹ 可容许**：设 `prior` 是**处处正**的概率向量，
且 `δ` 的 Bayes 风险严格小于任何其他规则 `δ'` 的 Bayes 风险；
则 `δ` 可容许。

证明（反证）：若 `δ'` 在每个 θ 处不更差且在某个 `θ₀` 处严格更好，
则由 `prior θ₀ > 0` 得 `bayesRisk prior L δ' < bayesRisk prior L δ`
（其余项 ≤，`θ₀` 项严格 <），与「严格最小」矛盾。
stmt:
theorem unique_bayes_admissible {prior : Fin n → ℝ} [Nonempty (Fin n)]
    (_hp : ProbVec prior) (hpos : ∀ θ, 0 < prior θ)
    {L : Loss n m} {δ : DecisionRule m} [Nonempty (Fin m)]
    (huniq : ∀ δ' : DecisionRule m, bayesRisk prior L δ' < bayesRisk prior L δ →
      False) :
    Admissible L δ
proof:
by
  rintro ⟨δ', hle, θ₀, hlt⟩
  apply huniq δ'
  unfold bayesRisk
                              
  have hpt : ∀ θ ∈ Finset.univ, prior θ * risk L θ δ' ≤ prior θ * risk L θ δ :=
    fun θ _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hle θ) (le_of_lt (hpos θ))
  have hstrict : prior θ₀ * risk L θ₀ δ' < prior θ₀ * risk L θ₀ δ :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt (hpos θ₀)
  exact Finset.sum_lt_sum hpt ⟨θ₀, Finset.mem_univ θ₀, hstrict⟩

name: ece_le_sqrt_brier
doc:
ECE ≤ √Brier（Σ_b w_b = 1）。
证明：加权 Cauchy–Schwarz (Σ w|d|)² ≤ (Σ w)(Σ w d²) = Brier，
再由 ece ≥ 0、brier ≥ 0 用 `Real.le_sqrt` 开方。
stmt:
theorem ece_le_sqrt_brier {B : ℕ} (w acc conf : Fin B → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ b, 0 ≤ w b) (hws : ∑ b, w b = 1) :
    ece w acc conf ≤ Real.sqrt (brier w acc conf)
proof:
by
  have hcs : (∑ b, Real.sqrt (w b) * (Real.sqrt (w b) * |acc b - conf b|)) ^ 2
      ≤ (∑ b, (Real.sqrt (w b)) ^ 2)
        * (∑ b, (Real.sqrt (w b) * |acc b - conf b|) ^ 2) :=
    Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ _ _
  have hx : (∑ b, Real.sqrt (w b) * (Real.sqrt (w b) * |acc b - conf b|))
      = ece w acc conf := by
    unfold ece
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← sq, Real.sq_sqrt (hw b)]
  have hy : (∑ b, (Real.sqrt (w b)) ^ 2) = ∑ b, w b := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hw b)]
  have hz : (∑ b, (Real.sqrt (w b) * |acc b - conf b|) ^ 2) = brier w acc conf := by
    unfold brier
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hw b), sq_abs]
  rw [hx, hy, hz, hws, one_mul] at hcs
  exact (Real.le_sqrt (ece_nonneg w acc conf hw) (brier_nonneg w acc conf hw)).mpr hcs

name: high_conf_error_bound
stmt:
theorem high_conf_error_bound {B : ℕ} (w acc conf : Fin B → ℝ) (H : Finset (Fin B)) (δ : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ b, 0 ≤ w b) (hconf : ∀ b ∈ H, 1 - δ ≤ conf b) :
    ∑ b in H, w b * (1 - δ - acc b) ≤ ece w acc conf
proof:
by
  have h1 : ∑ b in H, w b * (1 - δ - acc b) ≤ ∑ b in H, w b * |acc b - conf b| := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro b hb
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hw b)
    have hle : 1 - δ - acc b ≤ conf b - acc b := by
      linarith [hconf b hb]
    have h2 := neg_le_abs (acc b - conf b)
    have h3 : conf b - acc b = -(acc b - conf b) := by ring
    calc 1 - δ - acc b ≤ conf b - acc b := hle
      _ = -(acc b - conf b) := h3
      _ ≤ |acc b - conf b| := h2
  have h4 : ∑ b in H, w b * |acc b - conf b| ≤ ∑ b, w b * |acc b - conf b| :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ H)
      (fun b _ _ => mul_nonneg (hw b) (abs_nonneg _))
  have h5 : ∑ b, w b * |acc b - conf b| = ece w acc conf := rfl
  linarith [h1, h4, h5.le, h5.ge]

end Lattice

  rw [dif_pos h]

name: stepIter_of_le
doc: `stepIter` 在 `n ≤ k` 时不动。
stmt:
theorem stepIter_of_le (M : FinSCM n) (topo : Fin n ≃ Fin n) {k : ℕ} (h : n ≤ k)
    (v : Fin n → Bool) : M.stepIter topo k v = v
proof:
by
  unfold stepIter
  rw [dif_neg (Nat.not_lt.mpr h)]

name: stepIter_apply_ne
doc: **`stepIter` 只改一个坐标**：`j ≠ topo ⟨k,_⟩` 时原样保留。
stmt:
theorem stepIter_apply_ne (M : FinSCM n) (topo : Fin n ≃ Fin n) {k : ℕ} (h : k < n)
    (v : Fin n → Bool) {j : Fin n} (hj : j ≠ topo ⟨k, h⟩) :
    M.stepIter topo k v j = v j
proof:
by
  rw [M.stepIter_of_lt topo h]
  simp only
  rw [if_neg hj]

name: solIter_succ
doc: `solIter` 的**后继展开式**（定义等式，供 `rw` 使用）。
stmt:
theorem solIter_succ (M : FinSCM n) (topo : Fin n ≃ Fin n) (k : ℕ) :
    solIter M topo (k + 1) = M.stepIter topo k (solIter M topo k)
proof: rfl

name: solIter_succ_self
doc:
**第 `k` 步写定第 `k` 个变量**。

证明：`rw [solIter_succ]` 把左边展开为 `stepIter topo k (solIter …) (topo ⟨k,h⟩)`，
`rw [stepIter_of_lt]` 再展开为 `if topo ⟨k,h⟩ = topo ⟨k,h⟩ then feval … else …`，
`if_pos rfl` 即得。

**写法说明**：这里不能只用 `simp` —— `stepIter_of_lt` 的右端是
`fun j => if j = topo ⟨k,h⟩ then … else …`，`simp` 不会自动把
**外层函数应用**（`(fun j => …) (topo ⟨k,h⟩)`）beta-归约后再消 `if`，
故 `simp made no progress`。显式 `if_pos` 是稳的。
stmt:
theorem solIter_succ_self (M : FinSCM n) (topo : Fin n ≃ Fin n) {k : ℕ} (h : k < n) :
    solIter M topo (k + 1) (topo ⟨k, h⟩) = M.feval (topo ⟨k, h⟩) (solIter M topo k)
proof:
by
  rw [M.solIter_succ topo k, M.stepIter_of_lt topo h]
  exact if_pos rfl

name: solIter_succ_stable
doc:
**已写定的坐标不再改变**：`m < k` 时第 `k` 步不动 `topo ⟨m,hm⟩`。
用 `topo` 的单射性把 `topo ⟨m,hm⟩ ≠ topo ⟨k,hk⟩` 归到 `m ≠ k`。
proof:
by
  rw [M.solIter_succ topo k]
  refine M.stepIter_apply_ne topo hk (solIter M topo k) ?_
  intro heq
  have : (⟨m, hm⟩ : Fin n) = ⟨k, hk⟩ := topo.injective heq
  simp at this
  omega

name: solIter_stable
doc:
**引理 A（值稳定）**：`m < k ≤ k'` 时 `solIter M topo k` 与
`solIter M topo k'` 在坐标 `topo ⟨m,hm⟩` 上一致 —— 「一旦写定，永不再变」。

证明：令 `k' = k + d`，对 `d` 归纳。
* `d = 0`：`rfl`；
* `d + 1`：先由归纳假设得 `solIter k = solIter (k+d)`，
  再证「第 `k+d` 步不改坐标 `topo ⟨m,hm⟩`」——
  分「`k+d < n`（用 `solIter_succ_stable`）」与「`n ≤ k+d`（用 `stepIter_of_le`）」两支。

**写法说明（本文件实际修正过一次）**：初稿把 `ih` 当函数用
（`ih hk (Nat.le_add_right k d)`），Lean 报
`function expected at ih, term has type M.solIter topo k … = M.solIter topo (k+d) …`
—— 因为 `induction d` 之后 `ih` **已经**把外层 `k`/`k'` 实例化成了等式，
不再是待喂前提的函数。正确做法：**在归纳前就把该证明的形状固定**
（下面用 `suffices` 把 `k'` 显式化为 `k + d`），使 `ih` 保持「等式」形态，
从而可以用 `Eq.trans` 直接复合。
stmt:
theorem solIter_stable (M : FinSCM n) (topo : Fin n ≃ Fin n) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < n) :
    ∀ {k k' : ℕ}, m < k → k ≤ k' →
      solIter M topo k (topo ⟨m, hm⟩) = solIter M topo k' (topo ⟨m, hm⟩)
proof:
by
  intro k k' hmk hle
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
  subst hd
  clear hle
                                                          
  have haux : ∀ d : ℕ, m < k →
      solIter M topo k (topo ⟨m, hm⟩) = solIter M topo (k + d) (topo ⟨m, hm⟩) := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero => intro _; rw [Nat.add_zero]
    | succ d ih =>
        intro _
                                                                            
        have hind := ih hmk
                                                                    
        have hk : m < k + d := by omega
        by_cases hb : k + d < n
        · have hstep : solIter M topo (k + d) (topo ⟨m, hm⟩)
              = solIter M topo (k + d + 1) (topo ⟨m, hm⟩) :=
            (M.solIter_succ_stable topo hb hm hk).symm
          show solIter M topo k (topo ⟨m, hm⟩)
            = solIter M topo (k + d + 1) (topo ⟨m, hm⟩)
          exact hind.trans hstep
        · have hle' : n ≤ k + d := Nat.le_of_not_lt hb
          have hstep : solIter M topo (k + d) (topo ⟨m, hm⟩)
              = solIter M topo (k + d + 1) (topo ⟨m, hm⟩) := by
            rw [M.solIter_succ topo (k + d), M.stepIter_of_le topo hle']
          show solIter M topo k (topo ⟨m, hm⟩)
            = solIter M topo (k + d + 1) (topo ⟨m, hm⟩)
          exact hind.trans hstep
  exact haux d hmk

name: sol_apply
doc:
**`sol` 在第 `m` 个坐标上 = 迭代第 `m` 步写入的值**（其后各步不动它）。

证明：`sol = solIter n`；由 `solIter_succ_self` 得第 `m+1` 步写入的值，
再由 `solIter_stable`（引理 A，取 `k := m+1 ≤ k' := n`）说明
`m+1` 步之后该坐标**不再变化**。
stmt:
theorem sol_apply (M : FinSCM n) (topo : Fin n ≃ Fin n) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < n) :
    M.sol topo (topo ⟨m, hm⟩) = M.feval (topo ⟨m, hm⟩) (solIter M topo m)
proof:
by
  have hsol : M.sol topo (topo ⟨m, hm⟩) = solIter M topo (m + 1) (topo ⟨m, hm⟩) := by
    unfold sol
    exact (M.solIter_stable topo hm (k := m + 1) (k' := n) (by omega) (by omega)).symm
  rw [hsol, M.solIter_succ_self topo hm]

name: parent_index_lt
doc: **父坐标更早**（`ParentOrdered` 的消去形式）。
stmt:
theorem parent_index_lt (M : FinSCM n) (topo : Fin n ≃ Fin n) (hord : M.ParentOrdered topo)
    {i j : Fin n} (hj : j ∈ M.parents i) :
    (topo.symm j).val < (topo.symm i).val
proof: hord i j hj
